title: Proxy System for Reservoir Production
description: Reservoir simulation with CMG software, HDF5 dataset structuration, and transformer models trained as proxy systems to predict oil and gas reservoir production. Parallel computing with SLURM on HPC infrastructure.

title: Object Detection & AI Optimization
description: End-to-end object detection using TensorFlow 2 API — training, ONNX/Float16 optimization, TensorRT deployment. CI/CD delivery via Docker containerization for production-grade reliability.

title: Chest X-Ray Classification Web Service
description: Free web service for fast COVID-19 classification of chest X-Ray images using deep learning. Responsible for data QA, image preprocessing, and ML backend deployment integrated with user-friendly web interfaces.

title: AI Synthetic Data Generation & Augmentation
description: Generated synthetic images and videos to expand datasets and improve model robustness in text, image, and video processing. Enhanced generalization in CV and NLP models through advanced augmentation pipelines.

title: Photodetector Optimization with Genetic Algorithms
organization: Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)
description: Applied evolutionary genetic algorithms to optimize nanostructured photodetectors: material selection, doping profiles, and layer thicknesses across thousands of parallel multiprocessed simulations.

title: e-mulate Software Application
organization: Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)
description: Translated legacy Fortran code to Python to develop e-mulate, a GUI for electronic state calculations in quantum well heterostructures using transfer matrix and Numerov algorithms.

title: Django Web APIs for AI Services
description: Backend and frontend development of Python-based APIs bridging AI inference models (Transformers, Object Detectors) with interactive front-end portals for high-reliability deployment.

title: Cognitive Search Web Service
description: Free NLP-based information retrieval web service to search, classify, and extract critical data from millions of COVID-19 related scientific papers.

title: Nanostructured Photodetectors Simulation
organization: Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)
description: Python multiprocessing code for semiconductor structure simulations, validated by comparing calculated absorption spectra with experimental results for quantum Bragg mirror detectors.

title: Laser Performance Optimization
description: Optimization of multi-junction laser architectures, waveguide structures, and tunnel diodes. Research mapping operational voltages while maintaining high device output power, spanning simulations and cleanroom fabrication.

title: GaInNAs Epitaxy Growth (Ph.D. Thesis)
description: GaInNAs material growth via MOVPE to reduce carbon background. Complete characterizations using AFM, Photoluminescence, and ECV for highly efficient multi-junction solar cell prototypes. Ph.D. thesis research.

title: InAs Quantum Dots Characterization (M.Sc.)
description: Characterized novel semiconductor structures containing InAs quantum dots using high-precision optical and morphological methods. Engineered automated software for processing AFM image data. M.Sc. thesis.

title: Piezoelectric Displacement Control (B.Sc.)
description: Designed a closed-loop control system using interferometry to characterize and correct hysteresis and drift in Piezoelectric Disk displacements as a function of applied steady-state voltage. B.Sc. thesis.

title: Michelson Interferometer Assembly
description: Custom Michelson interferometer for nanometric displacement characterization. Logic controllers bridging hardware to software with ±1 nm positional tracking resolution.

title: Data Science & ML Mentorship Programs
description: Designed and delivered immersive tutoring programs on Python, data manipulation, machine learning techniques, and AI ecosystem architecture best practices for real-world deployments.
